question: Which among the following festivals is celebrated as the Telugu New Year?
solution:
The correct answer is **Ugadi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Ugadi **is one of the famous festivals celebrated among the** Hindus **with great pomp and fanfare. Ugadi is celebrated as the New Year of the Telugu and Kannada people.
 
• The festival of Ugadi is celebrated on the first day of Chaitra month according to the Hindu calendar.
 
• On the other hand, according to the Gregorian calendar, this festival falls in March or April.
 
• With the arrival of spring, this festival also marks the arrival of a new crop for the farmers.
 
• On the day of Ugadi, Lord Brahma, the creator of the universe, is worshipped.
 
• This festival brings us very close to nature and on this day a drink called Pachadi is made which is very healthy.
 
• On this auspicious day, people in South India also start new work, such as starting a new business, home entry etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Monpa Tribe:**

 
• The Losar Festivals are celebrated in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• It is celebrated by the people of the Monpa Tribe who are said to be inhabitants of Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• Losar is a 3-day festival, which is celebrated with great pomp and show in Tawang.
 
• The festival is observed to ward off evil spirits and welcome the new year that shall be filled with happiness and prosperity.

**Vishu:**

 
• Vishu marks the beginning of the New Year for the people of Kerala. 
 
• The festival is celebrated in the month of Medam of the Malayalam calendar with much pomp and vigour.
 
• The most important part of the festival is the Vishukani.
 
• Apart from Kerala, the festival is celebrated in neighbouring regions like Mangalore, Tulunadu, and Udupi.
 
• Vishu is also called the festival of fireworks and light as the celebration includes the bursting of firecrackers. It is said that Krishna killed the demon Narakasur on the day of Vishu.

**Dasara or Mahanavani:**

 
• Dasara is observed as a State festival - Nadahabba in Karnataka.
 
• It's a 10-day festival, the last day being Vijayadashami.
 
• It is a day when Hindu Goddess Chamundeshwari killed the demon Mahishasura.
 
• After the fall of the Vijayanagar kingdom Raja Wodiyar, 1 continued the festival in 1610 at Srirangapattana.
 
• During the reign of Krishnaraja Wodeyar III, in 1805, the tradition of having a special durbar (royal assembly) in the Mysore Palace during Dasara was started.
